name: treework
description: State-native project memory for long-running coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: State-native project memory for long-running coding agents.
interface.longDescription: TreeWork is a Codex plugin that turns accepted project intent, design, structure, branch reality, and verification into recoverable state. Its three-stage protocol guides coding agents through Alignment, declarative Tree construction, and one verified branch at a time. Durable transitions, branch-local documents, Recall, Project Map, and Replay keep long-running work aligned with project reality.
defaultPrompt: Use TreeWork to align this project, design its Specs and Tree, then traverse from the control workspace into one isolated branch at a time.
Recall the current TreeWork branch and continue from its Spec, Plan, and recorded reality.
Open this project's read-only TreeWork Project Map.
